rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone actively persuades another person or changes their mind through reasons or arguments.

example.english: He used reason to convince me.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 dou6 lei5 seoi3 fuk6 zo2 ngo5

rows.traditional: 令到 A 相信 B
rows.jyutping: ling6 dou3 A soeng1 seon3 B
rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on evidence or an action causing A to believe B, rather than on persuading A as an interaction.

example.english: The data in the report is enough to convince me that what he said is true.
example.traditional: 份報告入面嘅數據令到我相信佢講嘅係真嘅。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 ge3 sou3 geoi3 ling6 dou3 ngo5 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 zan1 ge3

rows.jyutping: jin2 dak1 ci5 mou4 ci5 joeng6
rows.note: Use this specifically when an actor portrays a role so convincingly that they look and behave like the character.

example.english: They act so convincingly that they convince everyone they really are a doctor.
example.traditional: 佢演得似模似樣，成班人都相信佢真係個醫生。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jin2 dak1 ci5 mou4 ci5 joeng6 sing4 baan1 jan4 dou1 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 ji1 saang1
